# Rider

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/player/mount.h`](../../../src/logic/player/mount.h) · Described in `data/player.json`

A player that rides: gets on the animal it touches with a jump, steers it, sits on it.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `reach` | `float` | m from the body to the animal to get on (0.3) |
| `seat` | `float` | m from the saddle up to the eyes (0.9) |
| `stiffness` | `float` | 1/s of the seat's spring (9) |
| `max_acceleration` | `float` | m/s^2 the seat gives at most (40) |
| `settle` | `float` | s over which the seat's pull comes in (0.5) |
| `lost` | `float` | m from the seat: fallen off (2) |
| `hop` | `float` | m/s to the side when getting off (1.8) |
| `mount` | `entt::entity` | written: the animal ridden |
| `was_jump` | `bool` | written: jump as last seen |
| `blend` | `float` | written: 0 getting on, 1 seated |
| `seat_position` | `glm::vec3` | written: the saddle this frame, world |
| `seat_velocity` | `glm::vec3` | written: the saddle's velocity, smoothed |
| `seat_known` | `bool` | written: seat_position is valid |
| `left` | `entt::entity` | written: collider of the animal just left, not collided with yet |
| `left_timer` | `float` | written: s before it is |

## Notes

On FPS players (makeFPSPlayer), with PlayerLegs, an input component and a PlayerView. Written by Mounting and RiderSeat, read by MountSteering and Mountables.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: MountSteering, Mountables. Written by: Mounting, PlayerSpawn, RiderSeat. Created by: PlayerSpawn. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [MountSteering](../systems/MountSteering.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick | the animal ridden |
| [Mountables](../systems/Mountables.md) | system | Host | **read** | preinit (storage), tick | the players whose distance makes colliders |
| [Mounting](../systems/Mounting.md) | system | Host | **readwrite** | tick, mount, dismount | reach, seat, lost, hop, blend read; mount, was_jump, blend, seat_known, left, left_timer written |
| [PlayerSpawn](../systems/PlayerSpawn.md) | system | Host | **write+create** | init (makeFPSPlayer) | the FPS player can ride |
| [RiderSeat](../systems/RiderSeat.md) | system | Host | **readwrite** | tick, step | seat_position, seat_velocity (smoothed), seat_known written each frame; blend raised each step; seat, stiffness, max_acceleration, settle read |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[MountSteering](../systems/MountSteering.md)**
  - None.
- **[Mountables](../systems/Mountables.md)**
  - Connects `on_destroy<Mountable>` in preinit (disconnected in finish).
  - Reads the species' skin geometry (`resources/animals/species/<id>.bin`) once per species, runs `analyseGait` on its walk clip.
  - Creates a collider entity per Mountable within `range` of a Rider (or ridden) and destroys it when none is.
  - Logs once per species: `Mountables : <id>, saddle <h> m up on <joint>, walks <v> m/s, runs <v> m/s` (info), or a warning when the geometry cannot be read.
- **[Mounting](../systems/Mounting.md)**
  - `CollideShape` of the player's capsule, at its place and 0.6 m lower, with max separation `reach`, on a press of jump when not riding.
  - Sets the collision group of the ridden animal's collider; clears it 0.6 s after getting off.
  - On a jump off: `SetLinearVelocity` of the player (the saddle's velocity plus `hop` m/s to the animal's left and 1 m/s up).
- **[PlayerSpawn](../systems/PlayerSpawn.md)**
  - Creates entities: the player (and its two hands for VR) and `props` box entities in init; one Ground entity in preinit with `ground: true`.
  - No physics bodies itself: RigidBody (a later system) makes the Jolt bodies of the RigidBody components it adds.
- **[RiderSeat](../systems/RiderSeat.md)**
  - At each physics step: `AddForce` on the rider's body ((pull - gravity) x mass) and `ActivateBody`.
